name: Custom Shape Wavy Acrylic Plaque
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium wavy acrylic, featuring a unique textured surface that creates a decorative glass-like appearance.
    - The plaque has a 3 mm acrylic thickness, providing durability while maintaining a sleek and elegant look.
    - Comes with a transparent acrylic base 0.4 in ~ 1 cm thickness, designed to hold the plaque upright for a stable display securely.
    - Smoothly cut edges ensure a clean finish and safe handling.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 sizes: 6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm and 8 × 8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm.
    - Base size: 2.36 × 2.36 in ~ 6 × 6 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports double-sided printing, allowing designs to be visible from both front and back views.
    - The printing process ensures high-definition artwork, long-lasting color, and resistance to fading.
    - The textured wavy acrylic surface enhances the visual effect, giving the design a unique artistic appearance.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative acrylic plaque that highlights personalized artwork, names, or meaningful messages.
    - The transparent acrylic base allows the plaque to stand securely on flat surfaces.
    - Ideal for displaying on desks, shelves, bedside tables, or office décor spaces.
    - The wavy acrylic texture creates a distinctive visual effect, making the plaque stand out as a decorative keepsake.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, memorials, housewarming gifts, or special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who appreciates personalized décor and sentimental keepsakes.
    - Combines modern design with emotional value, making it a memorable decorative gift.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Wavy Acrylic Plaque

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
